Fallback for falsy fieldMatcher flips from deny to allow field access, a security-relevant edge case.
Operator precedence change makes length===0 alone sufficient, bypassing operator/array checks.
isMatchesAll always returns true regardless of ast, breaking inverted-rule matching logic entirely.
AND weakened to OR lets non-array values with matching operator satisfy the check incorrectly.
Operator check always passes, so any operator with empty array value wrongly counts as matchesAll.

Negation makes condition true for almost any operator except exact 'AND', broadening matchesAll incorrectly.
